notes.title: Finally, no more accidents!
notes.content:
[h2]Version 1.8 Patch Notes[/h2]
This update includes folliwing improvements and fixes:
[olist]
[*] When drawing a line it will not cut others until it's finished
[*] Added an ability to cancel current line while drawing using RMB
[*] Line will not cut itself anymore
[/olist]
+ Minor UI fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26168544/e1e7c7a5b42f91d5d55bdb0d98fa100863af8d86.png[/img]

notes.title: Maintenance Update 1.7.0
notes.content:
We just released minor update. New in version 1.7.0:
[list]
[*] Updated game engine
[*] SDL2 updated to version 2.0.9
[*] Multiple minor fixes
[*] Improved Default theme, now with snowflakes! :)
[/list]

We wish you a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
Starwind Games Team

notes.title: Dots eXtreme Patch 1.4.2
notes.content:
New update is available for download!

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Markers option added, you can turn it on to see symbolic markers on dots (this will help to distinguish dots of the same color and different brightness levels);
[*] Fixed bug which caused high CPU usage (4-6 times lesser now). Thanks to @ecramer for the report.
[/list]

Thanks for following and waiting for your feedback!
Starwind Games Team

notes.title: Dots eXtreme Patch 1.1.8 (Windows only)
notes.content:
Good news! First patch is here. Please check change log below:

[h1]What's new?[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Nature skin (lighter skin)
[/list]

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=766759891

[h1]Fixes and improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved skin selection, now you can see full preview, including buttons
[*] Fixed broken 12x12 - level 19 (unreachable cell)
[*] Fixed lag on sound volume change
[*] Fixed background animations bug during game
[*] Fixed buttons position in main menu
[/list]

Thanks for following, new update is coming within few days. We planning to release Mac OS version and to add more skins.

Please let us know if you found a bug.
